[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Starlink (@Starlink); megjelent: 2026-10-26T15:53:16+00:00; link: https://x.com/Starlink/status/2114747196226859108; média: nincs média]
Starlink Mobile is now live in Brazil with @vivobr! 50M customers can use apps and messaging in cellular dead zones — with 7M phones already connected. This is the first nationwide service to cover the entire country. 
 
The next-gen service - Starlink Mobile V2 - will make sure all Brazilians have access to high-speed mobile internet, from small fishing villages deep in the rainforests to remote stretches of highways 🛰️📱
